items.note: Plan states the lemma (y_S gets y_S+x_S for any scratch values; three stages give (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a), restoring auxiliaries, a swap over F_2) and reproduces the proof: net change (JV+RG)x, central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 and (|S∩T|-1)/2, and the three-stage composition. The neighbour counts z_b, z_c and the wire-count formulas (769-781) are not given, but they are not part of the lemma's proof.

States D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}. Derives it with the paper's invariant: the stored array is the frame applied to the logical array, and linearity carries it through gates. Notes that auxiliary roles are included.

Plan gets right the form I-J/9, the orthogonality of triple lines, the interstage matching, the central loss P⊗F of dimension h on 3->4, the side edge 2->5 residual of dimension h-2, the telescoping to Wm-2N, L=Ich and L/N=100/539, 101/539. The full gate-label table (eq:motif-labels) and the gate order are only summarized. The lemma's last clause, that every binary residual has an orthonormal basis (proof at 1073-1102), is asserted in S1.3.3.3 and never derived.

States P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at the sources X_a, endpoint difference I_m and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m. Follows the proof: nested projections have rank equal to the dimension change, the N exceptional source edges are 2P_{U_a} of rank one, and the endpoint differences are evaluated.

Plan has the phase frames C_U, one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, and s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c. It follows the proof: weight is additive mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, odd weight gives eps=±1, the Hadamard conjugation, the 27-coordinate C^{-1} on X_a->Y_a with Z_{a,k} and i^{27k} corrections, and the sign undo.

Plan has L<N/2, the deficits N-2L_b and 2N-2L_c, the exact eta_b and eta_c, eta>20·2^{-50}, log m<20 and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-eta), which give s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. This is the paper's chain. The large integer values of s_b and s_c are not quoted.

Both lemmas are stated as infer steps with their content: digit permutation, move, split and merge, cyclic row split into W streams; controlled update y+a(controls) mod q^b when the offset costs b^{O(1)}, and unit scaling. No derivation is given.

Plan has A=E_1 Pi E_2 by elimination around the rightmost entry of the topmost nonzero row, lower-triangular changes in descending physical order as controlled shifts, and each one of Pi as add, interchange, subtract. This gives a interchanges plus O(V). The prime condition is slightly loose (see errors).

Plan covers the cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, the frames Phi_M with the endpoint identity giving H<-H+D, the three-update interchange, s recursive calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) giving O(e^tau), and the depth-first parking schedule. All follow the paper.

Plan borrows rho=ceil(k log W/(2 log q)) high digits as a row field of range at least W^k, pads to a multiple of W^k, splits the width into base-m pieces with a geometric sum O(Ve^tau), and pads [2^u] to [q^e]. This matches the proof. The unequal-width remark at 1740-1762 is not covered.

Plan conjugates by P_M with residual basis columns to get coordinate kernels, so each residual vector is one child (C^{±1})^{⊗f} on a slot. That gives s_c children, with inverse children via (-i)^f Z C Z. It also has H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D and basis changes as a fixed number of row additions.

Plan covers the eight parity-controlled operations composing to (00 10)(01 11), the packed cyclic shifts as chunk swap plus controlled shift, the guard interval, the union bound 80(f-1)2^{-K}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B with radix-sort repair, and the normalized extra terms. S1.5.4 leaves the MA^3 scan term to S1.5.4.6, and it does not mention that the top position j_{f-1} is handled separately by a two-bit XOR (2054, 2187-2193).

Plan has node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), q_0 row chunks with range 2^{q_0K}>=W^{k_0}, children of volume exactly V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves below d^{1/2}, the sum O(e^lambda+e^sigma d^{(1-sigma)/2}) under tau(1+2c)<lambda, and base-m pieces giving d^{lambda'}. Its derivation, the depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E with E=64(W+m+1)^3 and nu=11 (2479-2560), is missing, as are the uniform bounds on A_* at 2696-2730.

S0 only asserts that the n log n optimality conjecture fails in this model. It does not state what the lower bound or its negation means (liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0).

errors.says: The fixed odd prime q need only avoid the denominators of A's factorization.
errors.paper: q must avoid every denominator in the table of factors and inverses and also every numerator of a diagonal entry of an invertible factor, so that the triangular factors stay invertible mod q^b.

errors.says: The eight packed cyclic shifts perform the XORs at all f positions j_i at once, shifting by ±sum_i 2^{j_i}.
errors.paper: The shifts cover only j_0..j_{f-2} (sum over i<=f-2). The top position j_{f-1} is omitted at first and handled at the end by one two-bit XOR from Lemma elementary-streams.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound. Under S1 it builds the scalar exchange network, frames, labels and the dimension budget, then the two interfaces with s<Wm and tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, then the interchange and layer recurrences. S2 to S4 give the transform, convolution, resampling, chirp and recovery reductions, and S5 does the parameter balance to O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}). The thin spots are local: the orthonormal-basis argument for binary residuals and the guard-width depth recurrence are asserted rather than derived, and the conjecture-negation step is only named.

steps.note: Plan has v=binom(100,3), N=v^3, I=3v^2, the data pairs X_a,Y_a, and the fixed network sending (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) while restoring every auxiliary wire. m=h^3 is not written out; it is only called the dimension of the label space.
Plan has a common invertible frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge paying only for D_v D_u^{-1}.
Plan has nondegenerate tensor labels in an m-dimensional space, nested labels on every edge, and the only decrease on central wires from time 3 to 4, each losing h.
Plan has rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested labels, with the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one as the exceptions.
Plan has the sum of |Delta dim| equal to Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, from telescoping at gates plus twice the loss, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b after adding N source ranks.
Plan has L/N=300c/v equal to 100/539 or 101/539, below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 (bit) and 2N-2L_c>0 (complex), hence s<Wm.
Plan has the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m for X_a and 0 to I elsewhere, so with frames Phi_M the network applies H<-H+D on every role, scratch rows included.
Plan has A=E_1 Pi E_2, exactly a interchanges plus O(V) per edge of rank a, the interchanges as recursive calls, and s calls per node.
Plan has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20·2^{-50} and log m<20, giving F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: P07 reconstructs the whole chain of the central saving. The fixed bank-exchange network, frames that commute with gates, nested labels losing h only on central 3->4 edges, rank equal to dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L, the ratio L/N=100/539 below 1/2 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity giving the shear, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50} all appear with their defining content and in their roles. The only gap is that m=h^3 is never written explicitly.
